item.title: NIF Fund Controversy, CARICOM Reforms, Assault Probe
item.ns0:title: NIF Fund Controversy, CARICOM Reforms, Assault Probe
item.description:
Tonight on Our News, the political battle intensifies as the opposition demands an urgent accounting of hundreds of millions of dollars redirected from the National Investment Fund. We examine the critical findings of international observers calling for sweeping election reforms and provide an update on a high-profile sexual assault investigation that has sparked a national conversation. Plus, we take you inside the courts for a major development in a prison smuggling case and celebrate a significant milestone for new homeowners in the Family Islands.
